title: Sliding window rate limiting
text: A sliding window counts requests over a rolling interval rather than resetting at a fixed boundary.

title: Token bucket
text: A token bucket refills at a constant rate and allows bursts up to the bucket size.

title: Leaky bucket
text: A leaky bucket drains at a fixed rate, smoothing bursts into a steady outflow.

title: Retry-After
text: Servers signal how long a client should wait with the Retry-After header, in seconds or as a date.

title: Exponential backoff
text: Exponential backoff multiplies the wait between retries, usually with jitter to avoid synchronized retries.

title: Idempotency keys
text: An idempotency key lets a client retry a write safely, because the server recognizes the repeat.

title: Circuit breakers
text: A circuit breaker stops calling a failing dependency for a cooldown period instead of retrying into it.

title: Bulkheads
text: Bulkheads isolate resource pools so one saturated dependency cannot exhaust every worker.
